name: ripple

frames.best_why: The concentric rings are at their widest spread and most clearly separated from the centre.

tagline: Faint rings ripple outward from the centre of a dark stage.
summary: A decorative set of thin concentric circles that continuously expand and fade from the middle, giving a soft radar-like pulse behind content.
appearance: A black stage with a set of faint grey concentric rings centred in the middle, spaced closer together as they grow outward and fading with distance.
behaviour: The rings slowly expand and fade in an endless loop, each offset slightly in time from the next so a ripple spreads outward from the centre.
use_when: A hero or feature panel wants a calm, radiating focal point behind it.
avoid_when: Light designs: the rings are so faint they barely register on pale backgrounds.
customise: The base circle size, its opacity and the number of rings are props; ring spacing, growth and timing are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Eight plain divs animated by one CSS keyframe each; no script.

a11y.note: Decorative with no focusable parts; the endless expansion ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The rings are so low-contrast they nearly vanish in most frames.
polish_why: Calm, even ripple, but it is extremely faint and reads almost as a plain glow.
title: Ripple
